jobs.description:
A partner company is strengthening its team, and Nordic Investin is recruiting a Senior Software Project Manager. You want technical choices, delivery and production behaviour to reinforce each other, even when the constraints are difficult.
The partner is strengthening its capability in coordinated software delivery across product engineering quality and business stakeholders. You will connect delivery planning, scope control and dependency management while ensuring that risk governance and release readiness receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
The environment rewards early questions, visible trade-offs and engineering discipline. Security and operability belong in the design.
How you will work
You will work with product, architecture, security, operations and domain colleagues. The partner values short feedback loops, evidence from real systems and direct communication.
This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for coordinated software delivery across product engineering quality and business stakeholders.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for delivery planning and scope control.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around dependency management.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting risk governance.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve release readiness.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through stakeholder communication.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering coordinated software delivery across product engineering quality and business stakeholders in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of delivery planning and scope control.
Practical experience applying dependency management and risk governance.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving release readiness.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from digital product organisations and enterprise software programmes.
Exposure to stakeholder communication in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of coordinated software delivery across product engineering quality and business stakeholders is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The role offers meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on coordinated software delivery across product engineering quality and business stakeholders gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

jobs.occupation: Researcher in anaerobic microbiology, modelling and aI
jobs.description:
About the position
We are seeking a researcher in anaerobic microbiology with good technical and programming skills to work on a project related to mixotrophic gas fermentation. The aim of the project is to develop novel methods for enriching carbon-efficient microorganisms and characterising their metabolism.
Your background
We are looking for a candidate with practical experience in anaerobic microbiology and bioinformatics methods, such as the analysis of metagenomic sequencing data and metabolic modelling. Strong technical skills are also required, as the position involves the construction, further development and troubleshooting of bioreactors.
Experience in developing AI-based systems using large language models, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, is a strong merit. Such experience would also enable the successful candidate to contribute to an additional project focused on developing an AI-based advisory tool for farm-scale biogas production.
The candidate is expected to independently lead the experimental and analytical work within the project, collaborate with other researchers in the group, and supervise students.
Qualifications
PhD in biotechnology, microbiology or another relevant field
Knowledge of anaerobic microbiology and metabolic modelling
Practical experience in bioprocesses and associated technical skills
Very good written and oral English skills
Good programming skills in R or an equivalent programming language
Experience in software development
Knowledge of machine learning or other data-driven approaches to the analysis of biological datasets
Experience in supervising PhD students

Additional qualifications
Experience in developing AI systems based on large language models
Very good written and oral Swedish skills
Knowledge of biogas production

Assessment criteria
The assessment will be based on the applicant’s scientific competence and experience relevant to the research area of the position. Considerable emphasis will also be placed on personal qualities, particularly the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with other members of the research group and the wider scientific community. 
About us
The position is based at the Department of Molecular Sciences at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Uppsala. The project will be carried out within the Microbial Biotechnology research group. Please visit our https://www.slu.se/en/departments/molecular-sciences/ for more information.
Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU on our https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/.
Employment
Permanent employment
Scope
100% of full-time
Location
Uppsala, Sweden
Starting date
By agreement, but no later than December 2026.
Please submit your application by 26 November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

We are the global leader in dispensing solutions for liquid portion control. We specialize in creating dispenser solutions for businesses in the foodservice, personal care, and cleaning industries. Whether it is ketchup, mayonnaise, hand soap, or detergent - ASEPT ensures accurate and reliable liquid dispensing. We are committed to reducing the environmental footprint through sustainable dispensing solutions.
In addition to our base in Lund, Sweden, we have two more group companies located in the Netherlands and in the US. ASEPT Group has around 100 employees and are a part of Lagercrantz Group listed on NASDAQ Stockholm. Read more at www.asept.com
 
Business Development Manager to ASEPT 
Would you like to work with a unique product developed in Lund and used by customers worldwide? Are you passionate about Business Development and eager to drive sales to new and existing customers?
Then join ASEPT and be part of the company’s exciting growth journey! You will play a key role in keeping current business and developing new business by launching innovative products and services that help customers to be more successful.
Your customers will typically range from large companies like Kraft Heinz, Unilever and Orkla, quick-service-restaurant (QSR), to local smaller food producers. The position involves extensive collaboration, both internally and externally, and requires you to have excellent collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy being close to your customers, both in person and digitally, and see travel as a natural part of the role.
You will be part of a great team and a workplace with supportive and committed colleagues in a culture that is innovative, down to earth and growth oriented. For the right person, this is a great opportunity to build an exciting career in an international, fast-growing environment where you can make a real impact on the company’s continued journey. You will be part of the Sales & Marketing team in Lund with five additional colleagues and report to the Sales & Marketing Director at ASEPT AB.
 
Key Responsibilities
Customer Relationship Building: Foster long-lasting relationships with customers by understanding their needs (KAM).
Lead and motivate yourself and collaborate with the other parts of the ASEPT Group to achieve and exceed targets for customers in Europe and other parts of the world.
Strategic Planning: Develop and implement business plans to expand our market presence.
Market Awareness: Stay informed about our markets and competitors.
Performance Monitoring: Present sales reports and revenue forecast

Requirements
Proven experience in Sales or in a relevant role (e.g. KAM).
Successful track record in meeting or exceeding targets.
Strong business acumenship and preferably industry expertise
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration or relevant experience.
Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels of customer organizations
International B2B experience and fluency in both English and Swedish (other languages, e.g. German, French, or Spanish is an advantage).

Your background
As a person you have a strong and analytic business mind. Your background is probably either in B2B Sales or in some related field like Business Development / Key Account Management / Market Management. Experience from the food-service industry and being familiar with large food-producing companies or the quick-service-restaurant (QSR) industry will give you a head start but it’s not a necessary requirement. You are communicative, driven, target oriented and have a structured way of working as well as a positive “can do attitude”.
 
Application
In this recruitment ASEPT collaborates with Standby Workteam. We recruit continuously and you are welcome to submit your application as soon as possible. For more information about the position, please contact Kristian Berglund, Standby Workteam, +46 709 605 372.

Are you an experienced Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer with a strong understanding of vehicle electrical architecture and embedded systems? Do you enjoy working with complex system design challenges and shaping future vehicle solutions? Then this could be your next opportunity.
ALTEN is now looking for an Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer for an assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will work with system-level design and architecture, supporting the development of future vehicle solutions through robust Electrical & Electronics concepts and system design.
About the role
As an Electrical & Electronics System Design Engineer, you will drive system-level design activities related to vehicle electrical architecture, embedded systems, software platforms, and communication networks. You will evaluate technical concepts, define system solutions, and support development teams throughout the product lifecycle.
A key part of the role is understanding how functions and services are realized through software, electronics, sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces. You will work closely with architects, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure scalable and robust system solutions that support both current and future vehicle platforms
Main responsibilities
Drive system design and concept development activities within Electrical & Electronics systems
Define and evaluate electrical architectures, ECUs, communication networks, sensors, and actuators
Explore and assess alternative technical concepts during early development phases
Ensure alignment with Functional Safety and Cybersecurity requirements
Develop and document system concepts and technical solutions
Support diagnostic strategies and system documentation activities
Provide technical guidance and system expertise to development teams
Collaborate with architects, software developers, and stakeholders across the organization
Support vehicle-level integration of hardware and software solutions

Your profile
You are a structured and analytical engineer with extensive experience in system design and vehicle electrical architecture. You enjoy working from a holistic perspective and navigating complex technical environments involving multiple stakeholders and engineering disciplines.
We see that you have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or equivalent
Several years of experience in system engineering, system design, or function design within the automotive industry
Strong understanding of vehicle Electrical & Electronics architecture
Experience working with embedded systems and Electronic Control Units (ECUs)
Knowledge of software platforms such as AUTOSAR and/or Embedded Linux
Experience with automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet
Understanding of Functional Safety and Cybersecurity principles
Strong communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to both engineers and management
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious:
Experience with vehicle-level hardware and software integration
Experience working as a System Engineer, System Architect, or Technical Lead
Experience from complex electrical architectures within heavy vehicles or automotive products

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest engineering and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in around 30 countries. Our engineers carry out advanced projects throughout the product development cycle for leading companies in sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace, Energy, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are about 1,300 committed employees across 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north. For the sixth consecutive year, ALTEN has been recognized as one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, thanks to our strong focus on career development, innovation, and engineering excellence.
Visit www.alten.se to learn more about us.
